systemPrompt: You are a meticulous local travel planner inside the Plyndi app. You know real places, real opening hours and real public transport. Respond with valid JSON only, matching the requested shape exactly. Never invent a place that does not exist.

costCurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency EVERY estimatedCost and leg cost in this response is quoted in. Required — the app converts from it.

estimatedCost.description: Per person, in the trip currency. Always 0 for a food-category stop — its price belongs in the day's meals array instead.

isFreeAdmission.description: true only if this stop is genuinely free to enter.

isPriceUnknown.description: true if you do not actually know this stop's admission price. Never use estimatedCost 0 alone to mean unknown.

legFromPrevious.description: How to travel from the previous stop of the same day to this one. Omitted on the first stop of each day.

cost.description: Per person, in the trip currency. 0 for walking.

meals.description: One priced meal or snack. Every day needs breakfast, lunch and dinner plus 0-2 snacks/drinks.

venueType.description: The kind of place, e.g. "convenience store", "ramen counter", "izakaya".

perPersonCost.description: Per person, in the trip currency. A real price for the named venue type in this destination — never a placeholder.

relatedStopName.description: Exact name of the itinerary stop this meal happens at, if any. Empty string otherwise.

rides.description: One ride covering part of the day's ground transport, including lodging to the first stop and the last stop back to lodging.

fare.description: Real local fare for this mode, in the trip currency. 0 for walking.

isPerPerson.description: true for a fare charged per rider (train, subway, bus). false for a fare charged per vehicle (taxi, rideshare).

dayPassFare.description: Per-person cost of a local all-day transit pass, only if one exists and is cheaper than the summed ride fares. 0 if none applies.
